card.name: Numbers after changes in drug timing
card.fires_on: The space or number right before a size of change in absorption timing or exposure, such as Tmax, half-life or AUC changes in interaction text. It often comes just before a figure like 1 hour, 20 minutes or 50%.

modes.description: The gap or word right before an amount of time by which absorption or peak time shifts.
